gen-flavors-gf-krona-one: Chunky and playful, with a rounded-nib look. Flavors towers and keeps its diagonals hefty; Krona One is a loosely spaced sans that turns bulky if the body goes large.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-inika: Letters locked together like links in a fine chain. New Title delivers bold, modern punch through tall lowercase, while Inika's strength is a traditional feel and a see-through gap in each s.
